text.content:
A netrunner who wants to reach the Moon.

Role: Netrunner
Affiliation: Maine's crew
Known for: An Arasaka netrunning program she escaped from

Spoilers for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners. Born in Warsaw to an Arasaka veteran, Takeshi Kushinada, and Shimmer of 404 Squadron. Arasaka put her talent to work diving the Old Net for lost data until children in her program started dying; she ran.

After drifting across Europe and the States she came to Night City, saving up for a way to Luna. Kiwi brought her into Maine's crew.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.38
